description: Filter, sort and page the provider database; the same filters as GET /api/v1/providers. Returns {total, limit, offset, filters (as applied), warnings, providers}. Default listing_status is active and the default limit here is 20 (max 200). max_price is in each matching product's own price_unit (per GB, per IP…), so combine it with type and pricing_model. Product filters (pricing_model, max_price, min_countries, min_pool, targeting, country, rotation, unlimited_bandwidth) must all hold for the same product and never match unknown values, so they only match providers whose structured products are known; see warnings. Unknown prices, pools and country counts sort last.

certification.description: Certification or membership (ISO 27001, SOC 2, EWDCI, IWF).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "DE"): a product whose published country list (country_codes) includes it.

listing_status.description: Default "active"; "any" includes pre-launch, defunct, suspended and unverifiable listings.

max_price.description: Maximum price_from_usd, in the matching product's price_unit. Use with type and pricing_model (units are canonical per model: per_gb GB, per_ip IP/month, per_port port/month).

min_countries.description: Minimum number of countries (for the given type when type is set).

min_pool.description: Minimum advertised pool size in IPs.

order.description: Default asc for price and name, desc otherwise.

protocol.description: Protocol supported (for the given type when type is set).

q.description: Case-insensitive match on name, slug, alias, domain or legal entity.

rotation.description: A product offering this rotation mode.

unlimited_bandwidth.description: A product whose traffic is (true) or is not (false) unmetered.

name: search_providers
title: Search the provider database
